description: The checks of the 0.1.0b7 selftest (git tag v0.1.0b7), by name. The release plan calls this baseline '95 checks'; 0.1.0b7 itself has 84, and all 84 are kept (one renamed on purpose). The gate fails when one is missing from the current selftest.
checks: init writes sentinel.config.yaml
init detects stack profiles
config validates against the schema
doctor reports no config problems
init refuses to run without a shared repo
init rejects a value that is not a git URL
an empty shared repo is scaffolded with starter files
the scaffold is not pushed without being asked
the scaffold contains no workflow file (pushing one needs extra token scope)
shared ci writes the optional workflow
init still saves the config when the shared repo is unreachable, with a warning
doctor fails until the shared repo is cloned
run new refuses until the shared repo is cloned
an adhoc run needs no shared repo and no tier
stage render fills in the run slug
finishing an adhoc run releases no lock
shared set connects the workspace
run new works once the shared repo is cloned
the default config turns auto sync push on
sync push --auto does nothing when auto_sync_push is off
sync push without --yes or --auto is refused
the expected skills exist
every skill has valid frontmatter (name matches the folder, description present)
no skill contains a machine path or an unrendered placeholder
no skill depends on one tool's private mechanics
every sentinel command a skill mentions exists
every stage has exactly one standalone skill
standalone stage skills carry the isolation rule
the pipeline contract ships with the main skill
the main skill makes isolated stages the rule and names how each tool does it
the built-in agy runner can edit headlessly without the dangerous flag
a config without routing or runners passes doctor
all stage prompts render for shape single
all stage prompts render for shape fullstack
all stage prompts render for shape fullstack-mobile
sync-adapters --tool claude
sync-adapters --tool agents
sync-adapters --tool gemini
sync-adapters --tool cursor
generated Claude agents have valid frontmatter
generated skill has no machine path or unrendered placeholder
generated skill uses the sentinel command, not file paths
--version prints the packaged version
AGENTS.md block is idempotent
AGENTS.md block does not depend on a checkout path
sync pull clones the shared repo
run new takes a lock
a second run with the same slug is refused
resume points at the next stage
a tier can only be raised
stats shows how many stages ran inline, headless or as subagents
a teammate's workspace cannot take a slug that is locked
the teammate can take the slug after it is released
a well-behaved stage passes
writing into another repo is caught (exit 3)
a commit by a stage is caught (exit 3)
run finish releases the lock
run new rejects the slug '../escape'
run new rejects the slug 'a/b'
run new rejects the slug 'Up'
run new rejects the slug 'x..y'
run new rejects the slug '-lead'
run new rejects the slug 'a.lock'
run new rejects the slug ''
run new rejects the slug 'a b'
nothing was written outside the runs folder
spec set rejects a test name with a path
stage render rejects a bad slug
routing lists each stage with its runner and model
a repo-specific route beats the stage route
a different provider can be routed per stage
the model flag reaches the command even when the runner is redefined
another provider gets its own command and model
doctor flags a model on a runner that cannot take one
sync push --auto merges straight into main
no pull request branch is created
a conflicting push exits 4 and lists the file
continue refuses while markers remain
continue pushes after the agent resolves the conflict
the other workspace sees the merged file
release check passes on a clean change
release check fails on debug output and a token
scrubber removes tokens, home paths and emails
change map collects the changed files
